notes.title: Space Revolver Selected for BIC Exhibition!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621564/3f6418b4cb8719e6b3adf5f0427687c8050209d5.png"][/img][/p][p]🎉 Hello, everyone! We are [b]MKstudio[/b], the team behind [b]Space Revolver[/b].[/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that our game has been selected as a [b]Rookie Showcase title[/b] at the upcoming [b]Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC)[/b] this August! 🚀
We’re excited to finally share this news with all of you.[/p][p][/p][h2]BIC Event Information[/h2][p]📍 Venue: BEXCO, Busan
🕹 [b]Online Exhibition:[/b] August 8 – August 29 (Play the games with an online ticket from the comfort of your home)
🎮 [b]Offline Exhibition:[/b] August 15 – August 17 (Visit our booth in person & chat directly with the developers)[/p][p]Our team will be at the booth throughout the event, so if you’re attending, we’d love for you to stop by and say hi![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621564/f4ea5dec2dd2a50115e60f310caf0b1cc000d702.png"][/img][/p][h2]Development Updates[/h2][p][b]Space Revolver[/b] has been steadily progressing, with achievements such as being selected for [b]PlayX4 Indie Arcade, Indiecraft TOP 20, and Game Icon Seoul.[/b]
Recently, new developers and artists joined our team to expand the game's content, and we’ve also received support from the [b]Chungnam Global Game Center[/b], allowing us to focus even more on development.[/p][p][/p][p]After BIC, we’ll be releasing a brand-new [b]demo build[/b], so please stay tuned![/p][p]We can’t wait to meet you in Busan or see you online.[/p][p]Thank you, as always, for your support. 🙌[/p]
